examples.title: Water bill
examples.description: A quarterly residential water and wastewater bill. It shows an account summary, usage charts against the regional average, meter readings and charges by service, with a tear-off payment slip at the foot of the last page.

examples.title: Statement of account
examples.description: A business customer's statement of account across several properties. It lists every bill and payment with a running balance that carries across pages, and shows the opening and closing balances and what is owing by age.

examples.title: Works invoice
examples.description: A one-page A4 tax invoice to a builder for a new water connection and meter. It shows line items with GST per line and a discount, the subtotal, GST and total, payment terms, and a QR code that opens the online payment page.

examples.title: Letter to customers
examples.description: An A4 letter to residents about planned water main works in their street. It shows a letterhead on the first page, the address placed for a window envelope, merged fields in the text, a works schedule table and a signature block, with a short running header if the letter runs over.

examples.title: Operations dashboard
examples.description: Larkmere Water's one-page monthly operations dashboard for the board, on A4 landscape. Four KPI tiles that turn red when a target is missed, 12-month supply and response-time charts, complaints by category, and leaks repaired by zone and month.

examples.title: Meter readings report
examples.description: Larkmere Water's quarterly meter readings for the field operations team, on A4 landscape. A contents page of zones, then every reading grouped by zone with subtotals and a grand total, and unusual readings flagged.

examples.title: Backflow test certificate
examples.description: Larkmere Water's certificate that a backflow prevention device was tested, one landscape A4 page per device. Each shows the property, device, result and next test or re-test date, signature lines, and a QR code to verify it.

examples.title: Parts dispatch label
examples.description: A 4 × 6 inch shipping label for meters and parts sent from Larkmere Water's depot to a field crew, one page per parcel. Each shows the from and to addresses, parcel n of N, weight and contents, a Code 128 barcode and a DataMatrix code, and a FRAGILE or HANDLE WITH CARE stamp when the parcel needs it.

examples.title: Fieldbook user guide
examples.description: Quillmont Software's A4 user guide for Fieldbook, its site-inspection app: a cover with an illustration, a table of contents, numbered chapters with footnotes, note, warning and tip callouts from one component, left and right pages with mirrored margins and the chapter in the running header, and a two-column glossary. Version, limits, troubleshooting and glossary come from the data.

examples.title: Fieldbook release notes
examples.description: Quillmont Software's release notes for Fieldbook, newest version first from the data. Each change has a New, Improved, Fixed, Security or Deprecated badge coloured by a conditional style and a link to its issue; a contents list links to each version, and a known issues box appears when there are any.

examples.title: Fieldbook quick-start card
examples.description: Quillmont Software's A5 card for new Fieldbook users, in English or German from the same template: five numbered steps, the workspace's plan and support hours, and a QR code to the video guides. Every word comes from the i18n catalogues, and dates, numbers, prices and plurals follow the card's language.

examples.title: Certificate of completion
examples.description: Quillmont Academy's certificate for its Fieldbook Administrator course: one landscape A4 page for each participant who completed it, from a repeat that skips the others. Border art in the page background, the name set large, a distinction line for high scores, two signature lines either side of a centred seal, and a QR code to verify it.

examples.title: Monthly management pack
examples.description: Ostrand & Pell's monthly management pack on A4, for a month and a region you pick. Four KPI tiles that turn red when a target is missed, revenue against budget, utilisation and pipeline charts, fees by region and service line in a matrix, the pipeline and active projects, and each region's commentary. In the HTML viewer, regions open to their projects and projects to their notes.

examples.title: Expense claim
examples.description: A one-page A4 staff expense claim for Ostrand & Pell, an engineering consultancy. It lists each expense with its date, category, GST and amount and a thumbnail of its receipt, totals the claim, and ends with the claimant's declaration and the manager's approval.

examples.title: Purchase order
examples.description: A two-page A4 purchase order from Ostrand & Pell, an engineering consultancy, to a survey equipment supplier. Parameters choose the copy (supplier, goods receiving or accounts) and whether prices show. It has supplier and delivery blocks, line items with GST and totals, a Code 128 barcode of the PO number, an APPROVED stamp once the order is approved, and the terms and conditions on a last page of their own.

examples.title: Staff roster and timesheet
examples.description: A fortnight's roster and timesheet for one Ostrand & Pell team on a single A4 landscape page: a matrix of staff by day with the hours in each cell, overtime, annual leave, personal leave and weekends coloured by conditional styles, totals for each person and each day, summary tiles and a legend.
